title: Contents Packout & Storage Contents Authorization Terms, Deposit and Vault Count
content:
## Terms

1. The job must be in scheduled status when the contents authorization is signed or the job is cancelled.
2. The tier is fixed at booking from the scope in each tier's entry gate.
3. The contents authorization is signed by the owner of the contents, and on tiers that allow it the customer may declare a value for declared-value coverage at signing; a customer who declines declares 0.00.
4. Contents may be taken into custody on a self-pay job only after customer payments posted to the job total at least the tier's self-pay deposit.
5. Insurance-funded jobs require no deposit.
6. A scheduled job cancelled before signing carries no charge.
7. At custody start the vault count is the boxes packed divided by the tier's vault capacity, rounded up, with furniture packed into the same vaults; vaults may later be added or consolidated, and the vault count in force on the first day of a storage period is the count billed for that period.

**Retired clause.** Within term 7, the clause "the vault count in force on the first day of a storage period is the count billed for that period" is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current Contents Packout & Storage basis for counting the vaults charged. The rest of term 7, and every other term above, remains in force.

## Conditions the records must show

| Act | Condition | Shown by |
|---|---|---|
| Signing the contents authorization | job in scheduled status | the job's status on the company record, before signing |
| Cancelling the job | job in scheduled status | the job's status on the company record, before cancelling |
| Taking contents into custody on a self-pay job | customer payments posted to the job total at least the tier's self-pay deposit | the job's funding source and the customer payments posted to that same job, before custody |
| Taking contents into custody on an insurance-funded job | no deposit | the job's funding source |

The deposit test counts only payments posted to the job itself; what the customer says has been paid elsewhere does not meet it. The deposit figures, vault capacities and whether a tier allows declared-value coverage are the tier values on the product's rate cards.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical figures)

- With a hypothetical self-pay deposit of 400.00, payments posted of exactly 400.00 meet the deposit; payments posted of 399.99 do not.
- With a hypothetical capacity of 100 boxes per vault, 300 boxes at custody start give 3 vaults, and 301 boxes give 4 vaults, because the division is rounded up.
- A customer who declines declared-value coverage at signing declares 0.00.

superseded_clauses: the vault count in force on the first day of a storage period is the count billed for that period.
